name: evident-charts
description: Use when creating, revising, or reviewing explanatory data charts for a blog, report, paper, slide, newsletter, or social post. Includes matplotlib, seaborn, pandas .plot, ggplot2, Plotly, Altair/Vega-Lite, D3, and PNG/SVG charts. Also use for "critique this chart", "why does this plot look bad", or "make this figure better" with a chart image. Not for unrelated coding, software architecture diagrams, or non-data illustrations.
